It is with great excitement that the SASA Education Committee hereby announces the 2024/2025 SASA Third Year Bursary Competition. This competition is open to all current 2nd year Statistics/Mathematical Statistics students who are planning to enrol for Statistics/Mathematical Statistics at third year level at a South African university in 2025.

An applicant must be a SASA member to be eligible for this competition. SASA membership is free to any full-time student registered for a degree in statistics or a closely related field at an accredited South African tertiary institution.

[Apply for SASA Student Membership (FREE)](../apply-for-sasa-membership.qmd){.btn-sasa}

Applications for the SASA Third Year Bursary Competition must be completed online. Applications for the 2024/2025 round have closed; the 2025 recipients are listed on the [Bursaries and Scholarships](bursaries-and-scholarships.qmd) page. Details of the next round will be announced by the Education Committee.

## Important terms and conditions

- The SASA Education Committee will handle the adjudication process.
- The judges' decision will be final and there will be no correspondence regarding the decision.
- The deadline for applications is Monday, 6 January 2025, but we would prefer entries as soon as possible.
- Academic records of final results must be submitted before Monday, 6 January 2025.
